title: Argument type mismatch

sourceOfTruth.rule: Use the decompiled target method signature to update call sites.

symptoms: Argument N cannot convert from old type to new type.
A method changed one parameter type while keeping a similar name.
investigation: Read the argument index, source type, and expected type from the compiler error.
Search all call sites for the old argument shape.
Check version and symbol routes for known call-site migrations.
patchRules: Update every call site to the decompiled method contract.
Preserve business intent when converting values.
If the old argument encoded multiple meanings, choose the boolean or enum value that matches existing behavior and document it in .upgrade-state.json.
antiPatterns: Do not add unsafe casts just to satisfy the compiler.
Do not change method overloads or extensions without package evidence.
Do not update only the first call site found.

successCriteria: The CS1503 family for the method reaches zero.
No new runtime behavior ambiguity remains undocumented.
